SplitICAndOOC.Name: Split In Character and OOC messages? (Default value)
SplitICAndOOC.NameUser: Split In Character and OOC messages?
SplitICAndOOC.Hint: Activate to create dedicated IC and OOC tabs

ForceMessageToTab.Name: Force messages to be sent in current tab? (Default value)
ForceMessageToTab.NameUser: Force messages to be sent in current tab?
ForceMessageToTab.Hint: Transforms messages to IC in IC Tab, OOC in OOC Tab and Whispers in a Whisper thread

AddRollsTab.Name: Add a specific tab for Rolls? (Default value)
AddRollsTab.NameUser: Add a specific tab for Rolls?
AddRollsTab.Hint: Activate this to send all rolls to this new tab, and prevent them from appearing in any other tab (except Whispers)

HideInStreamView.Name: Should Tabbed Chatlog be disabled in the FoundryVTT /stream view?

PerScene.Name: Should In Character and Roll messages be split per Scene? (Default value)
PerScene.NameUser: Should In Character and Roll messages be split per Scene?
PerScene.Hint: Messages in IC and Rolls tabs will be hidden when not originating from the current scene

AutoNavigate.Name: Should new messages automatically swap to the corresponding tab? (Default value)
AutoNavigate.NameUser: Should new messages automatically swap to the corresponding tab?
AutoNavigate.Hint: Sent and received messages will change the currently viewed tab to force message display

HideWhispersInMainTabs.Name: Hide threaded whispers in IC and OOC tabs? (Default value)
HideWhispersInMainTabs.NameUser: Hide threaded whispers in IC and OOC tabs?
HideWhispersInMainTabs.Hint: Displays whispers only in their dedicated thread

FilterByTabsInChatNotifications.Name: Filter messages by tabs in chat notifications (chat log closed)? (Default value)
FilterByTabsInChatNotifications.NameUser: Filter messages by tabs in chat notifications (chat log closed)?
FilterByTabsInChatNotifications.Hint: If unchecked, all messages will be displayed in chat notifications

DIALOG.FlushWarning: All messages within the current chat tab will be permanently deleted.
